data.name: Ilakiya
data.gender_notes: Ilakiya is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ilakiya is a Sanskrit name derived from the word ‘Ila’, meaning 'goddess'. The name Ilakiya refers to the goddess of illusion, often depicted in Hindu mythology as the divine consort of Lord Shiva. She is believed to possess the power to create and manipulate Maya or the illusionary world. This name is also associated with the feminine aspects of Lord Shiva and is believed to bring grace, beauty, and mystical power.
data.etymology: Ilakiya belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess of Illusion.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ilakiya total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
